title: lysimachia tonsa var. simplex
intro: Lysimachia tonsa var. simplex, commonly known as Chinese goldenseal or goldenseal root, is a plant species in the genus Lysimachia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include stimulating the immune system, reducing fever, and alleviating symptoms of respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of Lysimachia tonsa var. simplex include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
